value.answer: This needs emergency care now - go to the ER. A fever of 38C or higher in a baby under 3 months has to be checked in person, even if baby seems well.
value.triage: Go to the ER now, do not wait it out. Call 911 if baby is hard to wake, limp, breathing fast or hard, has blue lips, has a seizure, or has a rash that does not fade. 811 can advise, but do not delay going to the ER.
